answer: Tie each identity to one carrier-verified phone number, stored only as a salted hash: one number, one identity, and reuse triggers revocation. A sybil farmer must buy a real SIM and pass carrier checks for every puppet, so attack cost grows with each fake, while honest agents join once and keep a clean signal. An orchard grows tree by tree, not by copying one tree a thousand times; fakes crumble like shale under audit. Limits: SIM farms exist, numbers change, and phone checks exclude people without one.
